content.text: Hurry up, hurry up! The match is about to start! Is everyone up?
I'm all set, home theater + imported snacks, time to enjoy~
@Ricky, you're living the high life! I'm just huddled under the covers watching on my phone. What a difference...
@Xiao Pi, I don't know much about the game, but I'm already here! Don't forget to explain the rules to me later.
@Big Liu Indeed, the gap is quite significant, but watching the game on a phone offers a unique experience! @Peach Alright, leave it to me!
Black whistle!! That was clearly offside! How did the referee make that call?
@Xiao Pi, don't rush, look at the VAR replay. It's clearly not offside; the lines are drawn clearly.
@Ricky I feel like the lines are drawn so complicatedly, how can you tell if it's offside or not?
@Xiao Pi, I think you're getting too worked up. VAR confirmed it wasn't offside—do you think the referee is blind?
@Ricky, is that line correct? Did you take a close look at the player's foot? There's clearly a subtle angle!
@Xiao Pi The angle provided by VAR is already very professional. If you don't believe it, take a closer look—there's no offside at all.
Stop arguing, you guys. I'm out for a night run, and listening to you debate offside is really boring.
@Iron Sister, I really admire you. The match was so exciting, yet you still went for a run. You truly have great perseverance.
Running is fine, but don't you think it lacks a bit of excitement? Don't regret missing out after the competition ends!
@Peach It seems you're in high spirits. Even though you don't understand the game, you can still feel the atmosphere, right?
@Xiao Pi Yeah, seeing you all discuss so intensely, I'm getting nervous too.
@Xiao Pi The moment of the goal was brilliant, but we still need to talk about the referee's decision.
@Ricky I think there might be an issue with the offside call. What do you think about the VAR line?
@Big Liu VAR has made it very clear, there was no offside, the referee's decision was inappropriate.
I'll stick with night running. Let's continue discussing the competition.
@Ricky Black whistle! The VAR line is clearly problematic, I think the referee is biased.
@Xiao Pi Your analysis has made me even more curious, what exactly constitutes offside?
@Peach Offside is when an attacking player is positioned closer to the opponent's goal line than the second-last defender at the moment the ball is passed.
@Big Liu That's correct, but the issue lies in the discrepancy between the referee's decision and VAR's judgment. We should respect technological means.
@Ricky I still think there's an issue; VAR can sometimes make mistakes.
It seems you won't reach a consensus, so I'll continue with my night run.
@Iron Sister, you're having it easy, while we're almost getting into an argument here.
@Peach Yeah, it's already bright in the morning, time to get ready for work.
Black whistle! Look, the referee raised the flag for offside, I just can't believe it!
Calm down, Xiao Pi. I posted a screenshot of the VAR replay. The lines clearly show it's not offside. Take a closer look.
@Ricky Your screenshot is quite clear, but what exactly was the referee looking at? The line drawn is obviously correct.
@小皮 What does "black whistle" mean? Does it refer to a referee intentionally making wrong calls?
@Peach Yeah, the referee is either blind or has issues! @Ricky Don't even mention your lines; the referee just doesn't look at those lines!
@Xiao Pi, don't get too worked up; it's normal for matches to have controversies. @Ricky, the lines you highlighted in the screenshot do seem fine, but could the referee have other grounds?
@Iron Sister, the referee's decision can't possibly go beyond the VAR line, right? This is technical evidence; even the players were stunned.
Look at the players' expressions—they're completely stunned. If this isn't a misjudgment, then what is it?
@Xiao Pi Wow, the player's expression is so shocked. Could it be that they also think the referee made a wrong call?
@Xiao Pi, this expression looks more like being speechless at the referee. There might indeed be an issue. @Ricky, what do you think?
@DaLiu I think the player's expression is more like dissatisfaction with their own teammate, possibly feeling that there was an issue with the coordination.
@Ricky Your analysis makes sense, but if the line drawing is correct, then the issue might indeed lie in the referee's interpretation of the rules.
@Iron Sister, understanding the rules? The offside line is clearly marked, and they still made the wrong call. How can that be understood? I just can't get over it!
@Xiao Pi Oh, don't be angry. Even though I don't understand sports, I feel there were quite a few controversies in this match. In the end, who won isn't that important.
Look at this, the coach is so angry he threw the bottle!
@Xiao Pi, look at the coach's expression; he's clearly unhappy with the referee's decision.
@Xiao Pi In this situation, the coach is also in a tough spot, under too much pressure.
I think these are all part of the competition, so just calm down.
@Xiao Pi Seeing the coach so angry, I'm really sweating for them.
Let's take a halftime break. This ham is really good.
@Ricky Your midnight snack looks way too fancy; I can only make do with instant noodles here.
Even if the game is exciting, I still choose to go for a night run. Health is important.
@Ricky Speaking of food, I really envy your ham.
No matter what, eating is the best way to relax.
Instant noodles are pretty good too. Come on, let me share this simple joy with you.
@DaLiu, this is another form of enjoyment for you—simple yet fulfilling.
@Big Liu Although it's simple, sometimes simplicity is the best.
I don't think the controversy surrounding this match will end here; there may be further repercussions.
Everyone, look at this penalty call!
@Xiao Pi From this angle, it's not very clear, but VAR shows it should be fine.
Penalty decisions sometimes rely on the referee's intuition, and @Ricky's VAR screenshot doesn't fully clarify the issue.
@Xiao Pi, I don't really understand, but I feel that referees can sometimes make mistakes.
I'll go for a run instead of getting involved in this argument.
Alright, no matter what, the championship is ours. Let's celebrate!
@Xiao Pi Haha, finally I can breathe a sigh of relief. The competition was really intense and thrilling.
@小皮 It seems your mood has improved, and the morning sun is lovely too.
However, I was still moved by this handsome star player; the close-up of him crying was so touching.
@Peach Yes, the emotions of athletes are truly moving.
@Ricky, next time there's a competition, remember to keep your imported snacks ready.
@Xiao Pi No problem, enjoy the delicious food and have a great time!
But we should take a break now; there's still work to be done.
@Big Liu is right, everyone should get some rest early. Let's schedule the next match!
@Ricky The VAR screenshot you posted doesn't show any issues at all. I still think it's a biased call!
@小皮 I have already shown the screenshot of VAR, the line indicates there was no offside. Please take a closer look.
@小皮 I think you should calm down. Ricky's screenshot does make a valid point.
I still think night running is more interesting. You can take your time studying the VAR issue.
@Ricky Your home theater looks amazing, I'd love to experience it too!
@Peach, you'd better watch the game first, even though I'm watching it from under the covers too.
@Big Liu, the instant noodle cup you posted reminds me of what I ate during the competition.
The outcome of the competition is excellent, and everyone should pay more attention to this.
I saw a close-up of the handsome soccer star crying, and it was so moving.
The game is over, and I continue running.
Look out the window, the sky is already bright.
@Big Liu Yeah, it's already dawn, and I'm still thinking about the penalty decision in the match.
@Xiao Pi Actually, the penalty decision was somewhat controversial, but the outcome was good.
I think exercising makes me feel better than watching sports.
@Iron Sister, your night running route looks great. Take me with you next time.

meta.full_summary:
对话开始。
(第1段摘要): 比赛开始前，大家通过图片展现了各自的观赛方式。比赛中裁判的越位判罚引发了小皮与Ricky的激烈争论，铁姐则对争论不感兴趣，选择夜跑。
(第2段摘要): 对话围绕比赛判罚展开，小皮与Ricky对VAR的争议持续，铁姐选择夜跑。桃子虽不懂球，但被讨论吸引。大刘对VAR表示支持，但也承认裁判判罚有疑问。
(第3段摘要): 小皮对裁判举旗越位的判罚表示强烈不满，Ricky用VAR截图反驳，认为技术证据明确无误。大刘和铁姐对裁判决策的依据提出质疑，认为可能涉及规则理解问题。桃子虽不懂球，但被争论吸引，试图缓和气氛。
(第4段摘要): 本段主要围绕比赛中的情绪反应和食物讨论展开，争议判罚引发的情绪依然影响着大家的对话，食物成为缓解紧张气氛的因素。
(第5段摘要): 比赛结束后，大家讨论了点球判罚，虽然有争议，但更关注最终的胜利和球员的情感表达。争议虽未完全消除，但比赛的结果让人满意。
(第6段摘要): 围绕比赛判罚和情绪反应的争论继续，图像推动讨论，最终大家稍微关注比赛结果。窗外天亮，讨论转向日常生活。
resolved_events: 比赛开始前的准备阶段
